title: George Lewis's health on the stand
summary: Rockwell recalls Lewis being ill and having a slight heart attack on the stand but finishing the night.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: um george george was sick off and on during this time and he would have i remember this one time he had a heart attack right on the stand a slight heart attack you know and they would tell say well get off you know but he would just stay right there and finish the finish the night and then sometimes he would have now he you'd have to talk to him i don't know if they were heart attacks maybe there were other types of attacks but they at that time they were thought to be heart attacks and he thought they were heart attacks and um i know at least one other occasion and i think it happened many times he would maybe not be with the band one night and then he'd come right back you know
